glossary.definition: (A) "Aircraft" has the same meaning as in section 4561.01 of the Revised Code and includes any part or equipment of the aircraft. "Aircraft" includes an abandoned aircraft, unless otherwise specified.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.71 to 1311.80 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(B) "Abandoned aircraft" means an aircraft to which both of the following apply:

(1) It is located on the premises of a public-use airport.

(2) The owner or operator has not paid any tie-down, hangar, rent, or storage costs for use of the premises for at least ninety consecutive days.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.71 to 1311.80 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Director" means the director or other chief executive officer of a public-use airport. "Director" includes the director's or chief's designee.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.71 to 1311.80 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Labor" means to repair, service, or maintain an aircraft.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.71 to 1311.80 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Materials" means all products and substances, including gasoline, oil, lubricants, accessories, parts, and equipment, that are furnished for an aircraft.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.71 to 1311.80 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Public-use airport" has the same meaning as in section 4563.30 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.71 to 1311.80 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(G) "Stores" means to keep an aircraft on real property owned by a person that is not the owner of the aircraft. "Stores" includes any necessary transportation of the aircraft to an appropriate location for its storage.
